name: com.applovin.adview.AppLovinFullscreenImmersiveActivity
description: When AppLovin uses immersive mode for a fullscreen ad, this Activity displays the ad without the usual system bars. It handles the same ad playback and closing as the standard fullscreen screen.
disableEffect: Immersive fullscreen ads from AppLovin will no longer open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.
